# Generated by tools/content.py
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			every_country = {
				limit = { OR = { tag = ROM tag = ATH tag = LAK tag = MKD tag = PRS tag = CAR } }
				set_variable = { ante_realm_states = num_controlled_states }
				every_subject_country = {
					PREV = { add_to_variable = { ante_realm_states = PREV.num_controlled_states } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_weekly = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { OR = { tag = ROM tag = ATH tag = LAK tag = MKD tag = PRS tag = CAR } }
				set_variable = { ante_realm_states = num_controlled_states }
				every_subject_country = {
					PREV = { add_to_variable = { ante_realm_states = PREV.num_controlled_states } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
